C-40.Name: In-app Guide, titlebar document tools (split, lock, copy) and a new home for document statistics
C-40.Summary: Backlog from the user's MarkView observations (2026-10-15): MarkView has a "Guide" button, split-view tools and lock / copy-document actions in the titlebar. Do the same, better: a guide that is a living, editable Mark document instead of a static help page; compact document tools in the titlebar; move word/character statistics out of the titlebar into a calmer place.

Problem.Description: New users do not discover Mark's features (WYSIWYG blocks, split view, structured copy, diff, live reload for agents). Document-level actions are buried in menus. The titlebar word count competes with the title and breadcrumbs.

Goals.R-1: Guide, better than a static help page: a "Guide" entry (titlebar ? button on Win/Linux, Help › Mark Guide and the command palette on all OS) opens a localized, editable sample document in a temporary tab: each section demonstrates a feature in place (try-it blocks: type a table, a callout, a mermaid diagram), shows the shortcut, and links to the command. Edits never touch a real file unless the user saves. Content versioned with releases so What's New (G10) can deep-link to the new section.
Goals.R-1a: "Connect your agent" — ONE universal prompt for any agent (user 2026-10-15: no per-agent variants), shown in the Guide and on the welcome screen (C-46) with a Copy button and a plain explanation of what happens after you give it to your agent: (1) the agent writes long plans/specs/reports to a .md file and opens it in Mark; (2) Mark reloads on every save and keeps your place; (3) you edit the page; (4) the agent re-reads the file and treats your edits as the next instruction. Prompt and explanation in all 10 UI languages (the prompt text follows the UI language). Baseline prompt (EN): "When you produce a plan, spec or report longer than ~50 lines, write it to a .md file and open it for the user: open -a Mark <file>.md. When the file changed after you wrote it, re-read it: the user's edits are your next instruction." Below the prompt, an "Advanced agent setup" link opens the hooks-based setup (C-47). On Windows the open command is `start mark <file>.md` (verify the actual CLI/handler before shipping).
Goals.R-2: Titlebar document tools (right side, per-OS gated like C-38 N1): split view toggle with a small menu (side by side / source only / preview only, sync scroll), lock (read-only toggle per tab, prevents accidental edits while an agent writes; shows a lock badge on the tab), copy document (one click → structured text by default, menu for Markdown / HTML / structured text, reusing C-3/C-32).
Goals.R-2a: Title bar trimmed (user 2026-10-15): the folder (Files) and TOC buttons leave the title bar; left = sidebar toggle, centre = file name, right = theme (Auto/Light/Dark icon) and Share. Outline becomes a slim "On this page" rail to the right of the text column on long documents (mockup board 7, user: «огонь»), highlighting the current section and jumping on click; hidden when the window is too narrow; toggled from View › Outline and ⌘T jumps to a heading. Files stay in the sidebar.
Goals.R-3: Statistics: remove the word count from the titlebar; show it in an optional slim status bar (lines · words · characters · reading time, selection-aware) — off by default on macOS, toggle in View and Settings — and in a popover from the document title (also file path, size, modified time).

G-1.Title: Design on canvas: titlebar tools, status bar / title popover, guide entry points (macOS light/dark, Windows)

G-3.Title: Guide document (EN, then 10 UI languages) + entry points

C-40.Dependencies: C-38 N3/N4 (titlebar and chrome visuals) — design together; C-25 for the MCP part of the agent section; G10 What's New deep links.

Constraints.Constraint: Lock is a view state (not file permissions); live reload still applies while locked.
Guide content must never be written to the user's files unless they choose Save As.

NonGoals.NonGoal: A web help centre (the site docs stay as they are, C-35 restyles them).

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A new user reaches every headline feature from the Guide in under a minute; lock prevents edits and is visible on the tab; copy document puts structured text on the clipboard in one click; statistics are visible on demand and gone from the titlebar.

AffectedAreas.M-011: titleBar, tabs, status bar, guide document, command palette
AffectedAreas.M-009: Help › Mark Guide, View › Status Bar menu items

C-40.VerificationIntent: Per-OS titlebar tests, e2e for lock/copy/guide, WebKit screenshot matrix, live check.
